series.name: 2021 AUX troubleshooting guide — wall/floor split E/F/P codes (27)
series.notes: Troubleshooting Guide & Error Codes AUX Brand 2021 (Macroclima/AUX PDF) — wall/floor split letter+digit codes. High (service manual). Separate from official global list — model/product-line scoped, never merged where digits diverge (E1/E3/E8/F6 meanings differ per line).

meaning.en: The indoor controller measured system current above its protection ceiling and stopped the unit, showing E0.
meaning.ur: Indoor controller ne system current apni protection ceiling se zyada parha, unit ko rok diya aur E0 dikhaya.

causes.en: Current transformer or power line feeding a reading above the limit
causes.ur: Current transformer ya power line limit se ooper reading de raha hai

causes.en: Indoor unit panel fault, compressor line fault or a short in the unit
causes.ur: Indoor unit panel fault, compressor line fault ya unit mein short hai

solutions.en: Isolate the supply and have the current transformer, power line and compressor lead measured
solutions.ur: Supply isolate karein aur technician se current transformer, power line aur compressor lead measure karwaein.

solutions.en: Replace the indoor unit panel only after the wiring and compressor have been cleared
solutions.ur: Sirf us waqt indoor unit panel badlein jab wiring aur compressor theek paye gaye hon.

source.title: Troubleshooting Guide & Error Codes AUX Brand 2021 (Macroclima / AUX)

notes.en: Inspection path given as current transformer to power line to compressor line to connector assembly; usual suspects are the indoor panel, power line, compressor and the complete machine.
notes.ur: Inspection path yeh diya gaya hai: current transformer se power line, power line se compressor line aur compressor line se connector assembly tak; aam tor par indoor panel, power line, compressor aur poori machine par shak hota hai.

title.ur: Indoor unit ke room temperature sensor ki kharabi

meaning.en: The indoor board detects the room sensor as short-circuited or open and reports E1.
meaning.ur: Indoor board ne room sensor ko short-circuited ya open parh kar E1 ki khabar di.

causes.en: Room sensor resistance out of range, shorted or broken
causes.ur: Room sensor ki resistance out-of-range, short ya tooti hui hai

causes.en: Damaged sensor lead, loose terminal or damp reaching the connector
causes.ur: Sensor lead kharab, terminal dheela, ya connector tak geela pani aa raha hai

solutions.en: Measure the sensor and expect roughly 15 kohm at 25 C for inverter models
solutions.ur: Sensor measure karein - inverter models ke liye 25 C par taqreeban 15 kohm aana chahiye.

solutions.en: Re-seat and dry the connector; if the code follows a borrowed sensor, replace the sensor
solutions.ur: Connector ko dobara baithakar sukha karein; agar code udhar se laya gaya sensor ke sath bhi aata hai to sensor badal dein.

source.title: Troubleshooting Guide & Error Codes AUX Brand 2021 (Macroclima / AUX)

notes.en: Manual warns that fitting a sensor of the wrong value shifts the sensed temperature and causes start-up or shutdown errors; blowing mode plus the displayed room temperature is a quick sanity check.
notes.ur: Manual warn karta hai ke ghalat value ka sensor lagane se sensed temperature shift ho jata hai aur start-up ya shutdown errors aate hain; blowing mode aur display par nazar aane wala room temperature ek quick sanity check hai.

meaning.en: The outdoor board detects the outdoor coil sensor as short-circuited or open and reports E2.
meaning.ur: Outdoor board ne outdoor coil sensor ko short-circuited ya open parh kar E2 ki khabar di.

causes.en: Outdoor coil sensor failed or its resistance is outside the valid band
causes.ur: Outdoor coil sensor fail ho gaya ya uski resistance valid band se bahar hai

causes.en: Damaged sensor wire, loose connector or a fault on the outdoor board
causes.ur: Sensor wire kharab, connector dheela ya outdoor board par fault hai

solutions.en: Check the sensor and its connector, then compare readings with the adjacent coil sensor
solutions.ur: Sensor aur uska connector check karein, phir readings ko paas wale coil sensor se compare karein.

solutions.en: Replace the sensor first; if the code stays, replace the outdoor board
solutions.ur: Pehle sensor badal dein; agar code bhi rahe to outdoor board badal dein.

source.title: Troubleshooting Guide & Error Codes AUX Brand 2021 (Macroclima / AUX)

notes.en: Manual's stated inspection path is sensor to sensor wire to connectors to the outdoor main control panel.
notes.ur: Manual ke mutabiq inspection path yeh hai: sensor se sensor wire, sensor wire se connectors aur connectors se outdoor main control panel tak.

meaning.en: The indoor board detects the indoor coil sensor as short-circuited or open and reports E3.
meaning.ur: Indoor board ne indoor coil sensor ko short-circuited ya open parh kar E3 ki khabar di.

causes.en: Indoor coil sensor failed, damp or disconnected
causes.ur: Indoor coil sensor fail ho gaya, geela hai ya disconnect hai

causes.en: Damaged lead or a fault on the indoor main control panel
causes.ur: Lead kharab hai ya indoor main control panel par fault hai

solutions.en: Measure the sensor against its nominal value and dry out any damp at the terminal
solutions.ur: Sensor ko us ki nominal value ke saath compare karke measure karein aur terminal par ka geela pani sukha kar dein.

solutions.en: Substitute a known-good coil sensor; if the code persists, attend to the indoor panel
solutions.ur: Known-good coil sensor lagayein; agar code barqarar rahe to indoor panel theek karein.

source.title: Troubleshooting Guide & Error Codes AUX Brand 2021 (Macroclima / AUX)

notes.en: Nominal given as 5 kohm or 20 kohm at 25 C depending on the sensor fitted.
notes.ur: Nominal 25 C par 5 kohm ya 20 kohm diya gaya hai, jo fitted sensor par depend karta hai.

title.en: Indoor fan or floor-standing sliding-door error
title.ur: Indoor fan ya floor-standing sliding door ki kharabi

meaning.en: The indoor board lost the expected feedback for the indoor fan, and on sliding-door floor cabinets the same code means the door position could not be confirmed.
meaning.ur: Indoor board ko indoor fan ka expected feedback nahi mila, aur sliding door wale floor cabinets par is code ka matlab hai ke darwaze ki position confirm nahi ho saki.

causes.en: Fan blade mechanically stuck, or a failed PG/DC indoor motor with broken speed feedback
causes.ur: Fan blade mechanically atka hua hai, ya speed feedback tootne ke sath PG/DC indoor motor fail hai

causes.en: On floor cabinets, a jammed sliding plate, failed synchronous motor or misaligned photoelectric switch
causes.ur: Floor cabinets par sliding plate jam ho jati hai, synchronous motor fail hota hai ya photoelectric switch ghalat jagah par hota hai

solutions.en: Switch off, free the fan or sliding mechanism, clean it and restart
solutions.ur: Band karein, fan ya sliding mechanism azaad karein, usse saaf karein aur restart karein.

solutions.en: Have a technician check the motor connector and the speed feedback line, then the photoelectric switch wiring on door models
solutions.ur: Technician se pehle motor connector aur speed feedback line check karwaein, phir door models par photoelectric switch wiring check karwaein.

source.title: Troubleshooting Guide & Error Codes AUX Brand 2021 (Macroclima / AUX)

notes.en: The manual has three separate sections for this one code (wall PG motor, wall DC motor, floor-standing sliding door) - that is why it carries three aliases. Fb points back to this code.
notes.ur: Manual mein is ek code ke liye teen alag alag sections hain (wall PG motor, wall DC motor, floor-standing sliding door) - isi liye iske teen aliases hain. Fb wapas isi code ki taraf point karta hai.

title.ur: Indoor aur outdoor ki communication error

meaning.en: The inverter unit cannot establish indoor-to-outdoor communication and reports the fault on both units.
meaning.ur: Inverter unit indoor se outdoor ki communication qayam nahi kar pa raha aur dono units par yeh kharabi dikhata hai.

causes.en: Inter-unit connecting cable damaged, loose or reversed
causes.ur: Inter-unit connecting cable kharab, dheela ya ulta hai

causes.en: Indoor or outdoor main control panel not powered, or a failed module panel
causes.ur: Indoor ya outdoor main control panel mein power nahi hai, ya module panel fail ho gaya hai

solutions.en: First confirm the outdoor unit powers up and its indicator behaves normally, then check the link cable end to end
solutions.ur: Pehle confirm karein ke outdoor unit power par aata hai aur uska indicator normally chalta hai, phir link cable end to end check karein.

solutions.en: Replace the outdoor panel or module panel only after cable and power supply have been excluded
solutions.ur: Sirf us waqt outdoor panel ya module panel badlein jab cable aur power supply baahar kar di gayi hon.

source.title: Troubleshooting Guide & Error Codes AUX Brand 2021 (Macroclima / AUX)

notes.en: Manual stresses that only three parts take part in communication - indoor panel, connecting cable, outdoor panel - but a non-running outdoor supply often mimics the same code.
notes.ur: Manual zor deta hai ke sirf teen parts communication mein hissa lete hain - indoor panel, connecting cable, outdoor panel - lekin outdoor supply na chalne par aksar yehi code dikha deta hai.

title.en: Display board to indoor control panel communication failure
title.ur: Display board aur indoor control panel ki communication kharabi

meaning.en: On cabinets with a separate display board, the display lost contact with the indoor panel and shows E8.
meaning.ur: Alag display board wale cabinets par display ka indoor panel se contact toot gaya hai aur woh E8 dikhata hai.

causes.en: Connection line between display and indoor panel loose or broken
causes.ur: Display aur indoor panel ke darmiyan connection line dheela ya toota hua hai

causes.en: Failed display board or failed indoor main panel, or an unmatched pair after a partial repair
causes.ur: Display board ya indoor main panel fail ho gaya, ya aadhi repair ke baad dono matched pair nahi hain

solutions.en: Re-seat or replace the connection line and restart
solutions.ur: Connection line dobara lagaein ya badal dein aur restart karein.

solutions.en: Fit a known-good indoor panel; if E8 clears the panel was at fault, otherwise replace the display board and keep them as a matched pair
solutions.ur: Known-good indoor panel lagayein; agar E8 clear ho jaye to panel kharab tha, warna display board badal dein aur dono ko matched pair ke tor par rakhein.

source.title: Troubleshooting Guide & Error Codes AUX Brand 2021 (Macroclima / AUX)

notes.en: Manual carries an explicit compatibility warning - if display or indoor panel is replaced and the code remains, both must be changed together.
notes.ur: Manual mein ek explicit compatibility warning hai - agar display ya indoor panel replace kiya jaye aur code bhi rahe, to dono ko sath mein badalna hoga.

title.ur: Indoor unit ka EEPROM fail hona

meaning.en: The indoor main panel could not read the parameter storage chip, so it reports Eb and will not run properly.
meaning.ur: Indoor main panel apna parameter storage chip parh nahi paya, is liye Eb ki khabar deta hai aur theek se nahi chalta.

causes.en: Bad contact on the EE chip
causes.ur: EE chip par contact theek nahi hai

causes.en: Failed indoor main control panel
causes.ur: Indoor main control panel fail ho gaya hai

solutions.en: Power down and re-seat or clean the EE chip contacts
solutions.ur: Power band karein aur EE chip ke contacts dobara lagayein ya saaf karein.

solutions.en: Replace the indoor main control panel if the chip still cannot be read
solutions.ur: Agar chip ab bhi read na ho to indoor main control panel badal dein.

source.title: Troubleshooting Guide & Error Codes AUX Brand 2021 (Macroclima / AUX)

notes.en: The indoor motor on the panel only works after the stored data is read, which is why the unit refuses to start.
notes.ur: Panel par laga indoor motor sirf tab chalta hai jab stored data parh liya jata hai, isi liye unit start hone se inkar karti hai.

meaning.en: The outdoor board cannot make the three-wire DC fan behave as commanded and reports F0.
meaning.ur: Outdoor board teen taron wale DC fan ko hukm ke mutabiq nahi chala pa raha aur F0 ki khabar deta hai.

causes.en: Outdoor fan stuck by foreign matter, or the fan motor failed
causes.ur: Outdoor fan kisi bahri cheez se atka hua hai, ya fan motor fail ho gayi hai

causes.en: Loose motor terminal or a fault on the outdoor control panel
causes.ur: Motor terminal dheela hai ya outdoor control panel par fault hai

solutions.en: Switch off and clear whatever is blocking the outdoor fan, checking that it turns freely
solutions.ur: Band karein aur outdoor fan ko block karne wali cheez hatayein, check karte hue ke woh azaadi se ghoomta hai.

solutions.en: Re-seat the motor terminal; if the code follows a substitute motor, replace the motor
solutions.ur: Motor terminal dobara lagaein; agar code badle hue motor ke sath chala jaye to motor badal dein.

source.title: Troubleshooting Guide & Error Codes AUX Brand 2021 (Macroclima / AUX)

notes.en: Applies to the 3-lead externally driven DC fan fitted to inverter outdoor units from 2012 onward, which has no speed feedback path.
notes.ur: Yeh 2012 ke baad wale inverter outdoor units mein lage 3-lead externally driven DC fan par lagu hota hai, jismein speed feedback path nahi hota.

meaning.en: The compressor power module saw overcurrent, overvoltage or overheating, raised a shutdown request and the unit reports F1.
meaning.ur: Compressor power module ne overcurrent, overvoltage ya overheating dekh kar band karne ki request ki aur unit F1 ki khabar deta hai.

causes.en: Supply voltage out of range, bad compressor or reactor wiring, or a blocked system
causes.ur: Supply voltage out-of-range hai, compressor ya reactor wiring kharab hai, ya system block hai

causes.en: Module panel damaged, outdoor main panel damaged or the compressor itself failed
causes.ur: Module panel kharab, outdoor main panel kharab ya compressor khud fail ho gaya hai

solutions.en: Check supply voltage first, then compressor and reactor wiring, then look for system blockage
solutions.ur: Pehle supply voltage check karein, phir compressor aur reactor wiring, phir system blockage ke liye dekhein.

solutions.en: Substitute a known-good module panel; if F1 persists, test the outdoor main panel and finally the compressor
solutions.ur: Known-good module panel lagayein; agar F1 bhi raha to outdoor main panel test karein aur aakhir mein compressor test karein.

source.title: Troubleshooting Guide & Error Codes AUX Brand 2021 (Macroclima / AUX)

notes.en: Parent fault of the whole Category-L series. Manual adds that on poor grids or ageing units the occasional F1/F3 pair is normal protection behaviour rather than a dead board.
notes.ur: Yeh poori Category-L series ka parent fault hai. Manual mein yeh bhi hai ke kharab grid ya purani units par kabhi kabhi aane wala F1/F3 pair normal protection behaviour hai, dead board nahi.

meaning.en: The power factor correction and boost stage shut down after seeing overcurrent or overvoltage.
meaning.ur: Power factor correction aur boost stage ne overcurrent ya overvoltage dekh kar band kar diya.

causes.en: Supply voltage outside the working window
causes.ur: Supply voltage working window se bahar hai

causes.en: PFC board, reactor or the data link to it failed
causes.ur: PFC board, reactor ya uski data link fail ho gayi hai

solutions.en: Measure the mains supply and the DC bus between P and N before changing parts
solutions.ur: Parts badalne se pehle mains supply aur P aur N ke darmiyan DC bus measure karein.

solutions.en: Check the PFC board data wire, then substitute a known-good PFC/module board
solutions.ur: Pehle PFC board ki data wire check karein, phir known-good PFC/module board lagakar dekhein.

source.title: Troubleshooting Guide & Error Codes AUX Brand 2021 (Macroclima / AUX)

notes.en: Manual notes the PFC function may be integrated into the module panel rather than on a separate board.
notes.ur: Manual ke mutabiq PFC function alag board par nahi balkay module panel ke andar hi integrate ho sakta hai.

meaning.en: The measured compressor current no longer matches where the rotor should be, so the drive reports F3.
meaning.ur: Paray gaye compressor current ki value ab rotor ki mutabiq position se match nahi karti, is liye drive F3 ki khabar deta hai.

causes.en: Compressor phase wires in the wrong order causing reverse rotation, or a seized compressor
causes.ur: Compressor phase wires ghalat order mein hone se reverse rotation ho rahi hai, ya compressor jam hai

causes.en: System blockage, damaged module panel or damaged outdoor main panel
causes.ur: System blockage, module panel kharab ya outdoor main panel kharab hai

solutions.en: Try swapping the compressor U-V phase wires and see whether the code clears
solutions.ur: Compressor ki U-V phase wires swap karke dekhein ke code clear hota hai ya nahi.

solutions.en: If wiring is correct, test system pressure, then the module panel, then the compressor winding
solutions.ur: Agar wiring theek hai to system pressure test karein, phir module panel, phir compressor winding.

source.title: Troubleshooting Guide & Error Codes AUX Brand 2021 (Macroclima / AUX)

notes.en: Manual states F3 is computed by the module chip while F1 is raised by the power module itself, and advises diagnosing the two together.
notes.ur: Manual kehti hai ke F3 module chip ki taraf se calculate hota hai jabke F1 khud power module ki taraf se raise hota hai, aur dono ko sath mein diagnose karne ki salah deti hai.

title.ur: Compressor ke exhaust sensor ki kharabi

meaning.en: The outdoor board found the compressor exhaust temperature sensor short-circuited or open.
meaning.ur: Outdoor board ne compressor ki exhaust temperature sensor short-circuited ya open paayi.

causes.en: Exhaust sensor failed or its resistance is wrong, including a damp lead
causes.ur: Exhaust sensor fail ho gaya ya uski resistance ghalat hai, jismein geela lead bhi shamil hai

causes.en: Loose terminal or damage at the outdoor main control panel
causes.ur: Outdoor main control panel par terminal dheela hai ya nuqsan hai

solutions.en: Measure the sensor - it should sit near 50 kohm when the compressor is off and drop toward 3 to 30 kohm once it runs
solutions.ur: Sensor measure karein - jab compressor band ho to taqreeban 50 kohm ke qareeb hona chahiye aur chalte hi 3 se 30 kohm ki taraf girna chahiye.

solutions.en: Borrow an adjacent sensor to see whether the code follows it; if it does not, replace the outdoor panel
solutions.ur: Paas wala sensor udhar lekar dekhein ke code uske sath jata hai ya nahi; agar nahi jata to outdoor panel badal dein.

source.title: Troubleshooting Guide & Error Codes AUX Brand 2021 (Macroclima / AUX)

notes.en: Strong warning in the manual - fitting a 20 kohm coil sensor here in place of the 50 kohm exhaust sensor makes the unit believe the gas is hotter than it is and trip protection repeatedly.
notes.ur: Manual ki khaas warning - yahan 50 kohm exhaust sensor ki jagah 20 kohm coil sensor lagane se unit ko lagta hai ke gas isse zyada garam hai aur yeh baar baar protection trip karti hai.

title.ur: Compressor ke top-head (cap) sensor ki kharabi

meaning.en: The top-head temperature protection switch is normally closed and opens when the compressor overheats; an open circuit here is reported as F5.
meaning.ur: Top-head temperature protection switch aam halat mein band rehta hai aur compressor zyada garam hone par kholta hai; yahan khula circuit F5 ki shakal mein report hota hai.

causes.en: Compressor top head actually too hot, above about 110 C
causes.ur: Compressor ka top head waqai bohat garam hai, taqreeban 110 C se ooper

causes.en: Failed top-head switch, broken sensor lead or a fault on the outdoor panel
causes.ur: Top-head switch fail, sensor lead tooti hui ya outdoor panel par fault hai

solutions.en: Check operating pressure and refrigerant charge first, since low charge overheats the compressor
solutions.ur: Pehle operating pressure aur refrigerant charge check karein, kyunki kam charge se compressor overheat ho jata hai.

solutions.en: Confirm the switch continuity against temperature and replace it or the outdoor panel as indicated
solutions.ur: Temperature ke sath switch ki continuity confirm karein aur jaisa indication aaye switch ya outdoor panel badal dein.

source.title: Troubleshooting Guide & Error Codes AUX Brand 2021 (Macroclima / AUX)

notes.en: Also shown by two separate blink patterns on the three-LED outdoor map. The manual's inspection chain runs from the top-head switch through its wiring to the outdoor panel.
notes.ur: Yeh three-LED outdoor map par do alag alag blink patterns se bhi nazar aata hai. Manual ki inspection chain top-head switch se hoti hui uski wiring se hote hue outdoor panel tak jati hai.

title.ur: Outdoor ambient temperature sensor ki kharabi

meaning.en: The outdoor board found the outdoor ambient temperature sensor short-circuited or open.
meaning.ur: Outdoor board ne outdoor ambient temperature sensor short-circuited ya open paayi.

causes.en: Ambient sensor failed or its lead is broken
causes.ur: Ambient sensor fail ho gaya ya uski lead toot gayi hai

causes.en: Damaged sensor wiring or a fault on the outdoor board
causes.ur: Sensor wiring kharab hai ya outdoor board par fault hai

solutions.en: Check the lead, connector and sensor resistance against its nominal value
solutions.ur: Lead, connector aur sensor ki nominal value ke sath resistance check karein.

solutions.en: Replace the sensor; if the code persists, attend to the outdoor panel
solutions.ur: Sensor badal dein; agar code barqarar rahe to outdoor panel theek karein.

source.title: Troubleshooting Guide & Error Codes AUX Brand 2021 (Macroclima / AUX)

notes.en: Manual also calls it the external room temperature sensor; on the LED map it has its own pattern.
notes.ur: Manual ise bahar wala external room temperature sensor bhi kehta hai; LED map par iska apna pattern hota hai.

meaning.en: The voltage sensing circuit saw the mains drop below about 135 V or rise above about 275 V and locked out.
meaning.ur: Voltage sensing circuit ne dekha ke mains taqreeban 135 V se neeche gir gaya ya 275 V se upar chala gaya, aur unit lock ho gaya.

causes.en: Grid voltage genuinely outside the window, common during load shedding
causes.ur: Grid voltage waqai window se bahar hai, load shedding ke waqt aam hai

causes.en: Voltage sensing on the module or outdoor panel misreading because of a wiring or component fault
causes.ur: Module ya outdoor panel par voltage sensing wiring ya component fault ki wajah se ghalat parh raha hai

solutions.en: Measure the incoming supply with a meter before touching the unit
solutions.ur: Unit ko chune se pehle meter se incoming supply measure karein.

solutions.en: Check reactor wiring and the DC bus; only then suspect the module or outdoor panel
solutions.ur: Reactor wiring aur DC bus check karein; sirf phir module ya outdoor panel par shak karein.

source.title: Troubleshooting Guide & Error Codes AUX Brand 2021 (Macroclima / AUX)

notes.en: Where the sensing point sits depends on the model - module panel or outdoor main panel. Highly relevant to Pakistan where supply swings are routine.
notes.ur: Sensing point kahan hai yeh model par depend karta hai - module panel ya outdoor main panel. Pakistan ke liye yeh bohat ahem hai jahan supply swings aam baat hain.

title.en: Outdoor main panel to module panel communication error
title.ur: Outdoor main panel aur module panel ki communication error

meaning.en: On split-board outdoor units the main outdoor panel lost data exchange with the module panel.
meaning.ur: Do board wale outdoor units mein main outdoor panel ka module panel se data lena dena kho gaya.

causes.en: Communication data wire (usually four cores) loose or broken
causes.ur: Communication data wire (amsal chaar cores) dheela ya toota hua hai

causes.en: Module panel without power, failed module panel or failed outdoor main panel
causes.ur: Module panel mein power nahi, module panel fail ya outdoor main panel fail hai

solutions.en: Check the data connector and measure module panel power before replacing anything
solutions.ur: Kuch badalne se pehle data connector check karein aur module panel ka power measure karein.

solutions.en: Substitute a known-good module panel to decide which side failed
solutions.ur: Known-good module panel lagakar faisla karein ke kaun si side fail hui.

source.title: Troubleshooting Guide & Error Codes AUX Brand 2021 (Macroclima / AUX)

notes.en: Explicitly exclusive of outdoor units where module and main functions share a single board.
notes.ur: Yeh un outdoor units par lagu nahi hota jahan module aur main functions ek hi board par share karte hain.

title.ur: Outdoor unit ka EEPROM fail hona

meaning.en: The outdoor main panel could not read its parameter storage chip and raises F9.
meaning.ur: Outdoor main panel apna parameter storage chip parh nahi paya aur F9 deta hai.

causes.en: Bad contact on the EE chip
causes.ur: EE chip par contact theek nahi hai

causes.en: Failed outdoor main control panel
causes.ur: Outdoor main control panel fail ho gaya hai

solutions.en: Power down and re-seat the EE chip
solutions.ur: Power band karein aur EE chip dobara lagaein.

solutions.en: Replace the outdoor main control panel if the chip still cannot be read
solutions.ur: Agar chip ab bhi read na ho to outdoor main control panel badal dein.

source.title: Troubleshooting Guide & Error Codes AUX Brand 2021 (Macroclima / AUX)

notes.en: No special tools required for this check according to the manual.
notes.ur: Manual ke mutabiq is check ke liye koi khaas tools ki zaroorat nahi.

title.ur: Recirculated air sensor (four-way valve) ka error

meaning.en: On electronic-expansion-valve models the return-air sensor used to judge valve and four-way valve behaviour is out of range.
meaning.ur: Electronic expansion valve wale models par woh return-air sensor jo valve aur four-way valve ka andaza lagata hai, range se bahar hai.

causes.en: Recirculated sensor failed, damp or disconnected
causes.ur: Recirculated sensor fail ho gaya, geela hai ya disconnect hai

causes.en: Four-way valve or its switch wiring fault, or a fault on the outdoor panel
causes.ur: Four-way valve ya uski switch wiring fault hai, ya outdoor panel par fault hai

solutions.en: Check the sensor lead from the sensor up to the outdoor panel connectors
solutions.ur: Sensor se lekar outdoor panel connectors tak sensor lead check karein.

solutions.en: Swap sensors to confirm, and inspect the four-way valve if the code does not follow the sensor
solutions.ur: Confirm ke liye sensors swap karein, aur agar code sensor ke sath nahi jata to four-way valve check karein.

source.title: Troubleshooting Guide & Error Codes AUX Brand 2021 (Macroclima / AUX)

notes.en: Manual states the sensor only exists on models fitted with an electronic expansion valve.
notes.ur: Manual kehti hai ke yeh sensor sirf usi models par hota hai jinmein electronic expansion valve lagi ho.

title.ur: Cabinet ke indoor fan ki kharabi

meaning.en: Floor-standing cabinet indoor fan fault - the manual lists the code but routes the technician to the E4 procedure.
meaning.ur: Floor-standing cabinet ke indoor fan ki kharabi - manual mein yeh code maujood hai magar technician ko E4 ke tareeqe par bhejta hai.

causes.en: Mechanical jam of the cabinet fan or a failed indoor motor
causes.ur: Cabinet fan mechanically jam hai ya indoor motor fail ho gayi hai

causes.en: Loose motor connector or a fault on the indoor panel
causes.ur: Motor connector dheela hai ya indoor panel par fault hai

solutions.en: Follow the E4 indoor fan checks - free the fan, re-seat the connector, then test the motor
solutions.ur: E4 ke indoor fan checks follow karein - fan azaad karein, connector dobara lagayein, phir motor test karein.

solutions.en: Substitute a known-good indoor motor to separate motor from panel
solutions.ur: Known-good indoor motor lagakar motor aur panel ko alag karein.

source.title: Troubleshooting Guide & Error Codes AUX Brand 2021 (Macroclima / AUX)

notes.en: Index-only entry - the 2021 manual has no dedicated Fb section and refers to E4, hence medium confidence despite the official table carrying Fb.
notes.ur: Yeh sirf index ki entry hai - 2021 manual mein koi dedicated Fb section nahi hai aur yeh E4 ki taraf refer karta hai, isliye official table mein Fb hone ke bawajood medium confidence hai.

meaning.en: The high-pressure switch opened three times within twenty minutes, either in standby or while running, and the unit locked out.
meaning.ur: High-pressure switch ne bis minute ke andar teen baar khul gaya, chahe standby mein ho ya chalta hua, aur unit lock ho gaya.

causes.en: Switch terminals loose, or the high-voltage switch itself failed
causes.ur: Switch terminals dheele hain, ya high-voltage switch khud fail ho gaya hai

causes.en: Real over-pressure from a blocked condenser or a failing outdoor fan
causes.ur: Condenser block hone ya outdoor fan fail hone se waqai over-pressure ban gaya hai

solutions.en: Check that the plug-in terminals are firm and inspect the switch
solutions.ur: Check karein ke plug-in terminals mazboot hain aur switch ko check karein.

solutions.en: Clean the condenser and confirm the outdoor fan runs before resetting
solutions.ur: Reset se pehle condenser saaf karein aur confirm karein ke outdoor fan chal raha hai.

source.title: Troubleshooting Guide & Error Codes AUX Brand 2021 (Macroclima / AUX)

notes.en: Manual names the switch cable, connector, switch and main control panel as the inspection chain.
notes.ur: Manual inspection chain ke tor par switch cable, connector, switch aur main control panel ka naam leta hai.

meaning.en: System charge dropped below roughly thirty percent, so cooling stopped to protect the compressor.
meaning.ur: System ka charge taqreeban tees percent se neeche gir gaya, is liye compressor ki hifazat ke liye cooling ruki.

causes.en: Outdoor service valves not fully opened
causes.ur: Outdoor service valves poori tarah khole nahi gaye

causes.en: Leak or crack in the evaporator, condenser or connection piping, or a very high ambient load
causes.ur: Evaporator, condenser ya connection piping mein leak ya crack hai, ya ambient load bohat zyada hai

solutions.en: Open the stop valves fully and re-check
solutions.ur: Stop valves poori tarah kholein aur dobara check karein.

solutions.en: Look for leaks at the evaporator, condenser and pipework and have the system repaired and re-gassed
solutions.ur: Evaporator, condenser aur pipework mein leaks dekhein aur system theek karwakar dobara gas bharwayein.

source.title: Troubleshooting Guide & Error Codes AUX Brand 2021 (Macroclima / AUX)

notes.en: Manual lists stop valve, evaporator, condenser and connection pipe as the usual suspects.
notes.ur: Manual mein aam suspects ke tor par stop valve, evaporator, condenser aur connection pipe likhe hain.

meaning.en: The outdoor coil sensor saw an excessive temperature, so the controller stepped the compressor frequency down.
meaning.ur: Outdoor coil sensor ne bohat zyada temperature dekhi, is liye controller ne compressor ki frequency kam kar di.

causes.en: Dirty or blocked system and condenser, or the outdoor fan not running
causes.ur: System aur condenser ganda ya block hai, ya outdoor fan nahi chal raha

causes.en: Outdoor coil sensor reading wrongly, or divider resistance failure on the outdoor controller
causes.ur: Outdoor coil sensor ghalat reading de raha hai, ya outdoor controller par divider resistance fail hai

solutions.en: Wash the condenser and filters and confirm the outdoor fan runs at full speed
solutions.ur: Condenser aur filters dhoyein aur confirm karein ke outdoor fan full speed par chal raha hai.

solutions.en: Have the outdoor coil sensor and the outdoor controller checked
solutions.ur: Outdoor coil sensor aur outdoor controller check karwaein.

source.title: Troubleshooting Guide & Error Codes AUX Brand 2021 (Macroclima / AUX)

notes.en: Present on the LED map as a cooling-overload blink pattern.
notes.ur: LED map par cooling-overload blink pattern ke tor par maujood hai.

meaning.en: The exhaust sensor measured discharge temperature above the allowed limit and shut the unit down.
meaning.ur: Exhaust sensor ne discharge temperature allowed limit se zyada parhi aur unit band kar di.

causes.en: System pressure abnormal, or blocked indoor and outdoor air inlets
causes.ur: System pressure abnormal hai, ya indoor aur outdoor air inlets block hain

causes.en: Discharge sensor reading high, or a fault at the outdoor panel
causes.ur: Discharge sensor zyada reading de raha hai, ya outdoor panel par fault hai

solutions.en: Clean the filters, indoor coil and outdoor coil and clear the air inlets
solutions.ur: Filters, indoor coil aur outdoor coil saaf karein aur air inlets khali karein.

solutions.en: Verify the exhaust sensor reading before replacing any board
solutions.ur: Koi bhi board badalne se pehle exhaust sensor ki reading verify karein.

source.title: Troubleshooting Guide & Error Codes AUX Brand 2021 (Macroclima / AUX)

notes.en: Frequent problematic part given as the indoor coil sensor - airflow starvation on the indoor side is a common root cause.
notes.ur: Aksar masla indoor coil sensor par bataya gaya hai - indoor side par airflow ki kami aam root cause hai.

meaning.en: Indoor coil temperature crossed the high limit and the unit shut down to protect itself.
meaning.ur: Indoor coil ki temperature high limit se upar chali gayi aur unit apni hifazat ke liye band ho gayi.

causes.en: Reduced air volume at the outlet or a blocked indoor fan
causes.ur: Outlet par air volume kam hai ya indoor fan block hai

causes.en: Indoor coil sensor drifting away from its true reading
causes.ur: Indoor coil sensor apni asal reading se door drift kar raha hai

solutions.en: Clean the indoor filters and fan and restore normal airflow at the outlet
solutions.ur: Indoor filters aur fan saaf karein aur outlet par normal airflow bahal karein.

solutions.en: Measure the indoor coil sensor at ambient temperature and replace it if it drifts
solutions.ur: Ambient temperature par indoor coil sensor measure karein aur agar drift kare to badal dein.

source.title: Troubleshooting Guide & Error Codes AUX Brand 2021 (Macroclima / AUX)

notes.en: Shown on the LED map as indoor high-temperature heating protection.
notes.ur: LED map par indoor high-temperature heating protection ke tor par dikhaya jata hai.

meaning.en: Indoor coil temperature fell to the freezing threshold during cooling, so the unit stopped.
meaning.ur: Cooling ke doran indoor coil ki temperature freezing ki had tak gir gayi, is liye unit ruka.

causes.en: Blocked indoor air inlet, clogged filter or a stalled indoor fan
causes.ur: Indoor air inlet block, filter ganda ya indoor fan ruka hua hai

causes.en: Indoor coil sensor reading wrong, or low refrigerant charge
causes.ur: Indoor coil sensor ghalat reading de raha hai, ya refrigerant charge kam hai

solutions.en: Switch off, clean the filters and coil and clear the indoor air path
solutions.ur: Band karein, filters aur coil saaf karein aur indoor air path khali karein.

solutions.en: Check the indoor coil sensor and the charge if the code returns
solutions.ur: Agar code wapas aaye to indoor coil sensor aur charge check karein.

source.title: Troubleshooting Guide & Error Codes AUX Brand 2021 (Macroclima / AUX)

notes.en: On the LED map this appears as indoor cooling freezing protection.
notes.ur: LED map par yeh indoor cooling freezing protection ke tor par aata hai.

meaning.en: The controller measured AC bus current above its set protection value and reduced the frequency instead of tripping outright.
meaning.ur: Controller ne AC bus current apni set ki protection value se zyada parha aur foran trip karne ke bajaye frequency kam kar di.

causes.en: System blockage raising compressor load
causes.ur: System blockage se compressor load barh raha hai

causes.en: Grid voltage outside the expected band, or a failing outdoor unit controller
causes.ur: Grid voltage expected band se bahar hai, ya outdoor unit controller fail ho raha hai

solutions.en: Measure the grid voltage and restart once after a cooling-off period
solutions.ur: Grid voltage measure karein aur thande (cooling-off) waqt ke baad ek dafa restart karein.

solutions.en: Have the system blockage checked and the outdoor controller tested
solutions.ur: System blockage check karwaein aur outdoor controller test karwaein.

source.title: Troubleshooting Guide & Error Codes AUX Brand 2021 (Macroclima / AUX)

notes.en: The manual also carries an unnumbered section listing function-protection prompts of the inverter outdoor unit (overcurrent, PG motor, communication, phase and supply cases) that are shown by the outdoor indicators rather than by an indoor digit code.
notes.ur: Manual mein ek bina number wala section bhi hai jisme inverter outdoor unit ke function-protection prompts likhe hain (overcurrent, PG motor, communication, phase aur supply cases) jo outdoor indicators par dikhate hain, indoor digit code par nahi.
